skill: Communicating between the technical and non-technical
expected_level_description: You can: - listen to and interpret the needs of technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage their expectations - manage active and reactive communication - support or host difficult discussions within the team or with diverse senior stakeholders

You can: - understand and help teams to apply a range of techniques for data profiling - source system analysis from a complex single source - bring multiple data sources together in a conformed model for analysis

You can: - advise senior stakeholders on data security, ethical or procedural risks - improve organisational awareness of data compliance and procedures - lead, guide and mentor teams in implementing secure data practices and maintaining compliance

You can: - establish cross-organisational data solutions that include all aspects of the data development life cycle - define and promote good practices for creating repeatable, reliable and reusable data solutions

You can: - test and evaluate the feasibility of unfamiliar and emerging technologies, or familiar technologies in new data contexts - share what you learn with the organisation, explaining potential benefits, risks, and practical considerations - recommend, design and implement innovative data solutions based on organisation objectives, user needs, and operational constraints
You can: - establish cross-organisational data integration standards and design patterns - guide teams in designing secure and interoperable systems and services

You can: - understand the concepts and principles of data modelling and can produce relevant data models - work across government and industry, recognising opportunities for the reuse and alignment of data models in different organisations - design the method to categorise data models within an organisation

You can: - design an appropriate metadata repository - suggest changes to improve current metadata repositories - understand a range of tools for storing and working with metadata - advise less experienced members of the team about metadata management
You can: - ensure that the right actions are taken to investigate, resolve and anticipate problems - co-ordinate the team to investigate problems, implement solutions and take preventive measures

skill: Programming and build (data and analytics engineering)
expected_level_description: You can: - lead the design, code, testing and deployment of secure, resilient and maintainable solutions - continuously improve the codebase and reliability of solutions - create automation to improve the software development life cycle - work with others to implement standards and good practice to ensure security, testability and maintainability of solutions

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements

You can: - design and build integrations using FHIR, HL7 version 2, and messaging patterns - write and profile FHIR resources and implementation guides - resolve complex mapping and data quality issues between systems
You can: - find and use the right codes for a data item or form - use terminology browsers and reference sets

You can: - design pseudonymisation and linkage methods that keep identifiers separate from analysis data - assess the re-identification risk of a data set or publication and choose suitable controls - advise teams on safe settings, such as trusted research environments
You can: - take part in hazard workshops and contribute to a hazard log - follow the clinical risk management process for your work - provide evidence for a clinical safety case, such as test results
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
